plants.detail: 245 refused plants caught and 85 accepted plants kept green; 39 of 39 checks proven both ways

probes.detail: every fact printed by its probe or found at its source line, every browser fact with the proof the rewrite ships

questions.detail: every question answered with resolving evidence, checker and rungs
